name: experienceOS
tagline: B2B SaaS for experiential agencies — campaigns, staffing, assets, lead capture, and reporting in one platform.
description: experienceOS is the operating system for experiential campaigns. Agencies and live-event teams use it to run programs end to end instead of stitching spreadsheets, Airtable, and decks together.

coverImage.alt: experienceOS dashboard overview with campaign KPIs, lead capture metrics, and traffic analytics

screenshots.alt: experienceOS campaigns board showing active and upcoming activations in Kanban view

problem: Experiential teams burn hours across disconnected tools. Campaigns, staffing, assets, and reporting live in different places, so post-event decks get rebuilt from scratch every time.
approach: Build one product around experiential workflows: campaigns as the spine, with staffing, assets, field capture, and reporting connected to the same program context.
solution: A multi-module SaaS platform for campaign operations — from setup and field execution through live engagement data and client-ready reporting.
features: Campaign management with locations, timelines, and status boards
Staffing and coverage tracking by event
Asset and inventory assignment across activations
architecture: Multi-tenant B2B SaaS organized around campaign → event → ops modules, with shared program context feeding staffing, assets, field capture, and reporting.
